diagnostics.message: `:resource.aws_cloudfront_distribution.default` has an explicit `depends_on = [aws_s3_bucket.origin]`, but this ordering is already established implicitly: the distribution's `origin.domain_name` is `local.bucket_domain_name`, which is computed from `local.bucket` via `aws_s3_bucket.origin.*.id`. Terraform propagates the dependency on `aws_s3_bucket.origin` through the local value, so the bare `depends_on` adds no ordering and can be removed.
